title: Inhalable DNA nano-adjuvant elicits robust lung-resident memory immunity against pneumonic plague.
authors: Fu, Shengnan; Li, Zhixin; Yin, Zhe; Zhang, Xi; Song, Xiaolin; Hu, Lingfei; Zhou, Dongsheng; Su, Xin; Dai, Chenxi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究可吸入DNA纳米佐剂增强肺组织驻留记忆免疫以抗肺鼠疫，虽涉及DNA结构设计与分子动力学模拟，但核心是免疫佐剂与疫苗，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, remains a deadly threat due to its high mortality and rapid progression. In our previous study, Yersinia pestis antigens formulated with CpG oligodeoxynucleotides show great potential against pneumonic plague, but these agonists display low TLR9 affinity, poor stability, limited cellular uptake, and weak induction of tissue-resident memory immunity. Here, we introduce AdjCRU, a cruciform DNA nano-adjuvant built on a four-way junction with each arm presenting looped CpG motifs (LoDNA) for TLR9 engagement. Guided by computational design and molecular dynamics simulations, the four-way junction is chosen over other nanostructures for superior TLR9 binding. AdjCRU is nuclease-resistant, prepared by one-step annealing of four single-stranded oligonucleotides. When administered via aerosolized intratracheal inoculation alongside Yersinia pestis recombinant antigen rV10, AdjCRU is effectively internalized into lysosomes of antigen-presenting cell (APC), inducing markedly enhanced APC maturation, germinal center reaction, systemic and mucosal antibody titers, and T/B cell activation. Notably, rV10+AdjCRU drives robust lung-resident memory T/B cell immunity, and significantly improves survival by 40 % over free LoDNA in a lethal pneumonic plague mouse model. By integrating programmability, biocompatibility, and enhanced TLR9 stimulation into a single, modular platform, AdjCRU offers a versatile strategy for next-generation mucosal adjuvants against respiratory pathogens.
abstract_zh: 由鼠疫耶尔森菌（Yersinia pestis）引起的肺鼠疫，因其高死亡率和快速进展，仍然是致命的威胁。在我们先前的研究中，以CpG寡脱氧核苷酸配制的鼠疫耶尔森菌抗原显示出对抗肺鼠疫的巨大潜力，但这些激动剂表现出低TLR9亲和力、稳定性差、细胞摄取有限，以及对组织驻留记忆免疫的诱导较弱。在此，我们引入AdjCRU，一种基于四向连接构建的十字形DNA纳米佐剂，每个臂呈现环状CpG基序（LoDNA）以结合TLR9。在计算设计和分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟的指导下，选择四向连接而非其他纳米结构，因其具有优越的TLR9结合能力。AdjCRU具有核酸酶抗性，通过四条单链寡核苷酸的一步退火制备。当通过雾化气管内接种与鼠疫耶尔森菌重组抗原rV10共同给药时，AdjCRU被有效内化至抗原呈递细胞（APC）的溶酶体中，显著增强APC成熟、生发中心反应、全身和黏膜抗体滴度，以及T/B细胞活化。值得注意的是，rV10+AdjCRU驱动了强大的肺驻留记忆T/B细胞免疫，并在致死性肺鼠疫小鼠模型中将生存率较游离LoDNA显著提高40%。通过将可编程性、生物相容性和增强的TLR9刺激整合到一个模块化平台中，AdjCRU为针对呼吸道病原体的下一代黏膜佐剂提供了一种多功能策略。
